selection_process: with a weightage of 85 marks Interview

Candidates who meet the qualifying criteria and whose online applications are accepted are provisionally shortlisted for the CBT. They must log on to the BEL website with their credentials to download and print the CBT call letter
and follow the instructions in it. Call letters will not be sent by e-mail or by post. Candidates will not be reimbursed the cost of travel to the CBT.
Candidates are provisionally shortlisted for interview on the basis of their CBT performance
discipline-wise and category-wise. The list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the BEL website through query mode.

The final selection is based on performance in both the CBT and the interview. Minimum qualifying marks apply to the CBT and the interview separately: 35% for General/OBC/EWS candidates and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Outstation candidates shortlisted for the interview are eligible for reimbursement of the to-and-fro AC Chair Car or III Tier AC train fare by the shortest route from their correspondence address to the place of interview. The results of candidates selected in the interview will be published on the BEL website. Candidates can choose to answer the CBT and the interview in English or Hindi. Eligibility has to be proved with original documents at the time of document verification
and appointment depends on being found medically fit by the Company's Medical Authorities.

how_to_apply: Keep these ready: a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number (both must stay valid for the whole recruitment process), a scanned passport-size colour photograph, a scanned signature in JPG/JPEG format and the other documents required by the advertisement.
Click the "Click here" link in front of "To Register" to start the online registration for BEL.
Step-I (Registration): fill in the Personal Details and Contact Details, press "Generate OTP", and enter the two OTPs sent to your mobile number and e-mail ID.

Tick the "I Agree" box after the Declaration, click "Re-verify", check the details and press "Submit". Your Application Sequence No. (User ID) and Password will be sent to your e-mail ID and mobile number.

Step-II (Application): click "Go To Application", or log in again with your User ID and Password. Then fill in the Personal Details, Additional Details, Communication Details, Qualification Details and Declaration, and choose 5 CBT centres.
Upload the relevant documents, including your photograph and signature. Click "Preview", correct any error and then click "Submit". Details cannot be edited after submission.
On the SBI e-Pay Lite payment gateway, check the details and pay the fee if your category has to pay. You will then return to your application form. Keep the Payment Acknowledgement Slip.
Press "PRINT" and save or print the application form as a PDF. The print option will not be available after the last date of online submission.

Photograph: recent passport-size colour photo with a white background, not more than 3 months old; .jpg or .jpeg format; 100 KB to 200 KB; scanner at 200 dpi; 3.5 cm (width) x 4.5 cm (height). Photos with a cap, hat or dark glasses are not accepted. Religious headwear is allowed but must not cover the face. Use the same photograph throughout the recruitment process.
Signature: sign on white paper with a black ink pen. Only the applicant may sign. Scan only the signature area, not the whole page, in .jpg or .jpeg format, 80 KB to 150 KB.
Age proof: a Matriculation/Higher Secondary certificate showing the date of birth, or a Birth certificate from the competent authority if that certificate does not show the date of birth.

EWS: an EWS Certificate / Income and Asset Certificate based on income for FY 2025-2026 and issued on or after 01.04.2026. The applicant's photo on it must be pasted, signed and stamped by the issuing authority.

OBC (NCL): a caste certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 01.10.2025, in the latest prescribed format for posts under the Government of India/Central PSUs. It must show the date of issue and the caste name spelt exactly as in the Central List. Candidates in the "Creamy Layer" must apply as Unreserved candidates.

SC/ST: a caste certificate in the latest format prescribed by the Government of India, showing the date of issue and the caste name. The caste or tribe must appear in the Central List of SC/ST of the respective state.

PwBD: a PwBD certificate in the latest format for the relevant category of disability, showing a disability of at least 40%. Conditions "likely to improve" under the temporary disability category are not eligible for reservation.
Ex-Servicemen: Annexure-3 in the prescribed format, signed by the competent authority.

At the interview (if shortlisted): the CGPA/GPI/SGPA to percentage conversion certificate/formula, where it applies, and a NOC from the current employer for candidates working in Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies.
At document verification: the relevant valid documents in original.

content_sections.heading: About BEL
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) is a Govt. of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence. The notice describes BEL as a Navaratna PSU and India's premier Professional Electronics Company, with a portfolio of over 350 different products. If that certificate does not show the date of birth, a Birth certificate issued by the competent authority will be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEL has advertised 350 Probationary Engineer posts in E-II Grade, including backlog vacancies: 200 in Electronics and 150 in Mechanical. Management may increase or decrease the number of posts in each specialisation.

faq.question: Q2. When does the BEL Probationary Engineer online application start?
faq.answer: Online registration for the BEL Probationary Engineer posts opens on 28 October 2026 at 02:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application with the fee is 18 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for BEL Probationary Engineer 2026?
faq.answer: GEN/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates pay Rs 1000/- + GST, i.e. Rs. 1180/-, online through SBI e-Pay Lite. SC/ST/PwBD/ESM candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BEL Probationary Engineer?
faq.answer: The maximum age for Unreserved/EWS candidates is 25 years as on 1 October 2026. OBC (NCL) candidates get 3 years of relaxation, SC/ST and Ex-Servicemen 5 years, PwBD 10 years, PwBD & OBC (NCL) 13 years and PwBD & SC/ST 15 years.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for BEL Probationary Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering degree in the listed Electronics disciplines or in Mechanical. UR/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates need a First class from AICTE approved Colleges, and SC/ST/PwBD candidates need a Pass class. A first class in AMIE / AMIETE / GIETE in these disciplines is also accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of BEL Probationary Engineer?
faq.answer: The basic pay scale is Rs. 40,000-3%-1,40,000, with a CTC of 13 lacs (Approx.). DA, HRA, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay, Medical Reimbursement and other perquisites are paid as admissible.

faq.answer: Selection is through a computer based test (85 marks) and an interview (15 marks). CBT performance decides shortlisting for interview in the ratio of 1:5, discipline-wise and category-wise.

faq.answer: Yes. 1/4th of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer in the 125-question, 120-minute CBT, and no marks are given for unattempted questions. The CBT is tentatively scheduled for 22 December 2026.
